rationale: The +1.79% gap has generated zero follow-through — the open equals the high at $13.65, three 1-minute candles are pinned flat at $13.63–$13.64 with fading volume, and the last tick sits a cent below the printed session low, only ~15bps above VWAP. With a 5-minute ATR (~$0.006) smaller than the round-trip spread cost and no news catalyst, neither the long continuation case nor the short fade case has a measurable mechanical edge, and the risk-off tape (SPY -0.69%, VIXY +3.27%) is pressuring both directions without producing an actual breakdown or thrust. Waiting for either a VWAP reclaim-and-drive or a decisive loss of VWAP with expanding volume is the correct action here.
